spanish: Y ancho del atrio a lado de mar, colgaduras cincuenta codo; sus columnas diez, y sus basas diez.
grammarChanges: del mar → de mar: removed the article-bearing contraction; יָם is absolute with no article, and the 'de' is licensed by the construct state on לִפְאַת (פאה), not by definiteness of mar.
readerNote: Chose 'de mar' over 'del mar' so the Spanish does not add a definite article the Hebrew construct (לִפְאַת ... יָם) does not carry.
